header.heading: Projects that
header.description: A selection of my recent work, from complex web applications to innovative tools that solve real-world problems.

items.title: Throughline
items.description: AI-assisted project planning that turns a brief into approved requirements, architecture, UI plans, and a traceable backlog. Changes flag the specific downstream work that needs review.

items.title: HRFlow
items.description: A synthetic-data HR and payroll demo covering employees, contracts, attendance, leave, payroll review, and payslips with role-based access.

items.title: Boardly
items.description: BillBoard Hub: a Next.js/MongoDB SaaS for booking and managing physical billboard ad space — advertisers reserve/pay (Stripe) for slots, admins schedule and approve, replacing manual, error-prone billboard sales coordination.

items.title: Lobby
items.description: Link-to-join Discord-style chat app (Angular + NestJS) with registered/anonymous Supabase auth, Postgres persistence, and LiveKit audio calls + screen share.

items.title: SRMS
items.description: SRMS is a role-based restaurant management system built to support the day-to-day workflow of a restaurant team from a single web platform.
